question.text: Any change in valuation methodology shall be construed as:

answer.text: A material change significantly influencing investor decisions

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 5.16.6 and Ch 8, any change in valuation methodology is a MATERIAL change requiring PPM update and disclosure. The Trap: Treating it as non-material or audit-only underplays investor impact. Cross-Exam Context: Also in SEBI (AIF) Second Amendment Regulations, 2023. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Quarterly CT flag on valuation methodology is part of Compliance Test Report.
